admin-port.description: Admin port. Provides an administrative UI for this instance.

cpus.description: CPU shares to allocate to each linkerd instance.

resource-roles.description: The accepted resource roles (e.g. slave_public). By default, this will deploy to any agents with the "*" or "slave_public" roles.

description:
Subject: Linkerd Deployment Configuration – Upcoming Release  

Hi team,

For the upcoming release we’ll be deploying Linkerd with three instances. Each instance will be allocated 0.5 CPU shares and 512 MB of memory. The administrative UI will be exposed on port 9990, while the service routing will use port 4140 and the internal routing port will be 4141. The deployment is targeted at agents that have the resource roles “*” or “slave_public”, ensuring it can run on any suitable node in the cluster.

Please verify that the resource quota limits accommodate these settings and let me know if any adjustments are needed before we proceed with the rollout.
